name: KDockW
short_summary: A Wayland-native dock for KDE Plasma 6 with parabolic zoom, PipeWire window previews, and multi-monitor support.

relation.rationale: KDockW is a spiritual successor to Latte Dock for KDE Plasma 6 on Wayland. Both organize application launchers and running windows in a dock. KDockW supports parabolic hover zoom, PipeWire window previews, and multi-monitor dock layouts.

steps: When authorized to submit, sign in to the intended AlternativeTo contributor account and verify its email address. This preparation kit does not sign in or submit anything.
Open the existing KDockW listing at submission.entry_url. Review its current metadata and available contribution controls; do not create a duplicate application.
Verify that KDockW remains listed among the Latte Dock alternatives at relation.entry_url. Maintain the existing relationship rather than adding it again.

Update the existing listing's name and summary only where needed using name and short_summary. Use alternativeto.txt for the full description without adding URLs, email addresses, postal addresses, or phone numbers.

Map the public catalog metadata in fields to the corresponding authenticated controls: Free and Open Source; GPL version 3 or later (GPL3+, represented here as GPL-3.0-or-later); Linux and KDE; Application Launcher; OS & Utilities; Byeonghoon Yoo; C++; and English. The authenticated control labels have not been verified.

Enter fields.Official Website and fields.GitHub repository in their dedicated link controls only. Keep these links out of the summary, full description, and alternative rationale, and do not add tracking parameters.

Review the existing icon and screenshots. Update media where needed with kdockw-avatar-400.png, kdockw-dock-overview.png, kdockw-dock-zoom.png, and kdockw-settings.png, using captions and alt text where controls are available. Avoid duplicate gallery images and review previews for clipping and readability.
Use relation.rationale only if updating the existing Latte Dock relationship through an available explanation or opinion control. Do not create a duplicate relationship.
Leave optional paid priority review unselected. Review the name, summary, URL-free description, license, platforms, category, links, media, and existing Latte Dock relationship.

Stop before final submission or publication until the maintainer authorizes the update. Record any resulting reference and status without claiming moderator approval or a published update before it is observed.

limitations: The authenticated submission form was not inspected. The fields object uses public catalog labels, not verified private input names or an AlternativeTo submission API. Name and short_summary are kit handoff values, not claims about private field labels.
The public FAQ publishes no short-description character limit or screenshot dimension limit. This kit does not invent either restriction.

The FAQ suggests a square PNG or SVG icon at least 280 by 280 pixels with a transparent background. The supplied 400 by 400 PNG meets the format, square shape, and size recommendation; its dark background is opaque, so it does not follow the suggested transparency.

The screenshots are existing repository product captures, not verified captures of the exact {{tag}} binary. They show the dock, zoom, and Appearance settings, and do not demonstrate a live PipeWire window preview.

KDockW already has a public listing at https://alternativeto.net/software/kdockw/ and appears among the Latte Dock alternatives. Preparing this kit does not update either destination; authenticated validation and any moderation remain external steps.
No optional payment is chosen, and this kit promises no review turnaround or approval.
